description: This Java source file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView implementation that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface. It formats and displays log messages within an Android application, supporting log level formatting, exception details, and chainable logging nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView component that displays log data received via the LogNode interface, supporting log formatting and chainable logging.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and appends a log message to the LogView, including log level, tag, message and optional exception details. Ensures UI thread safety for updates.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a string to a StringBuilder if it is not null or empty, with a delimiter.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the log display.
